turns.user_utterance: I have got out the wrong amount from an ATM. Please tell me the process to get the cash back as in app its showing the amount i have been actually received.
turns.assistant_response: Sorry about that—if an ATM dispensed the wrong amount, the usual next step is to submit a “wrong cash received” claim from the app. Could you confirm whether the withdrawal was successful (amount debited from your card) and whether the ATM receipt shows a different amount than what you received?
